KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Viwakilishi vya sifa vya pekee viulizi.

2. When practising Kusikiliza kwa Kina Sauti /g/ na /gh/, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. fupi

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)

   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
